title: Calendar: a failed reschedule toasts the raw server sentence "Record ID not found in OBJECT_NAME", untranslated, with the machine object name and the record id
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names · acceptance[0]

The failing clause of `ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names` in the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`), rule R-4 there, met while running `records-forms.calendar-interactions` acceptance[1] (which itself passes: the card rolls back). Reproduced twice.

## Reproduction (stock showcase)

1. Mint a contributor-bound member and assign it a task: `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID {"assignee": MEMBER_EMAIL}`. The member switches the language to 中文 in the avatar menu.
2. As the member open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/calendar`.
3. As admin reassign the task away: `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID {"assignee":"ada@example.com"}`.
4. As the member drag that card to another day.

Expected: a translated message that names the object by its label (任务 / Task), with no raw id.

Actual: the PATCH answers 404, the card rolls back correctly, and the toast reads `Record WB5z1sLAsWgE1tXL not found in showcase_task`: English on a zh-CN session, the machine object name, the raw record id.

## Mechanism

`ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`, around line 1346: the error toast takes `declaredUserMessage(err)`, then a permission branch (`isPermissionError`), then `extractWriteErrorMessage(err)`. A 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND is not a permission error, so the toast shows the server's `error` text, built by `packages/core/src/utils/record-not-found.ts` line 55 (`Record ${id} not found in ${object}`). A 404 on reschedule (the row was deleted or is no longer visible) has no translated, labelled branch. The shared `extractWriteErrorMessage` may be the better place for the fix.

Owning package: `@object-ui/plugin-calendar`. Full evidence: #31486, slice C3b.
